mapper.select:
WITH PTCP_LIST AS ( SELECT /*팀설문이면 부모ID, 일반설문이면 자기자신ID를 기준ID로 설정*/ NVL(SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID ) AS BASE_SRVY_ID , PTCP.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID )
SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM DESC, SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM ASC) AS RN , SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , NVL(( SELECT COUNT(X.USER_ID) AS PTCP_CNT FROM PTCP_LIST X WHERE X.BASE_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID GROUP BY X.BASE_SRVY_ID), 0) AS PTCP_CNT , CASE WHEN FN_DTTM() > SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM THEN '마감' ELSE ( CASE WHEN FN_DTTM() < SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM THEN '예정' ELSE '진행중' END ) END AS SRVY_STS , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.REG_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY WHERE SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL )X WHERE X.RN <= #{limitTop}
/* 설 명 : 과목별설문목록조회 */ SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM , SRVY.* , '' RESBMSN_EDTTM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY WHERE 1 = 1 AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.profSrvyListPaging 설 명 : 교수설문목록페이징 */
WITH SBJCT_USER AS ( /* 과목 수강생 목록 */ SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ), SUB_SRVY AS ( /* 팀설문 목록 */ SELECT SRVY_ID, UP_SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY_TYCD = 'SRVY_GNRL' AND UP_SRVY_ID IS NOT NULL ), SRVY_BASE AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM DESC, SRVY.REG_DTTM ASC) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(*) OVER () AS TOTAL_CNT , SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY.SBJCT_ID , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SUB_SRVY SS WHERE SS.UP_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID) THEN 'SRVY_TEAM' ELSE 'SRVY' END AS SRVY_GBN , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.MRK_RFLTYN , SRVY.MRK_RFLTRT , SRVY.MRK_OYN , SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN , SRVY.REG_DTTM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SBJCT_USER) AS SRVY_TRGT_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN SP.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS SRVY_PTCP_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN SP.SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS SRVY_EVLTEE_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP SP ON SP.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER) AND SP.SRVY_ID IN ( SELECT SRVY_ID FROM SUB_SRVY WHERE UP_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID UNION ALL SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID FROM DUAL ) WHERE SRVY.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL
AND LOWER(SRVY.SRVY_TTL) LIKE FN_LIKE_VAL(LOWER(#{searchValue}))
GROUP BY SRVY.SRVY_ID, SRVY.SBJCT_ID, SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.MRK_RFLTYN, SRVY.MRK_RFLTRT, SRVY.MRK_OYN , SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN, SRVY.REG_DTTM ) SELECT * FROM SRVY_BASE

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.sbjctMrkOynSrvyCntSelect 설 명 : 과목성적공개설문수조회 */ SELECT COUNT(SRVY_ID) FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND MRK_OYN = 'Y' AND SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY_TYCD = 'SRVY_GNRL' AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}
AND SRVY_ID <> #{srvyId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.mrkRfltSrvyList 설 명 : 성적반영설문목록 */ SELECT SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND MRK_RFLTYN = 'Y' AND SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY_TYCD = 'SRVY_GNRL' AND UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvyGrpSbjctList 설 명 : 설문그룹과목목록조회 */ WITH BASE_SRVY AS ( /* 기준 설문 */ SELECT * FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' ), SUB_SRVY_RANKED AS ( /* 하위 설문 */ SELECT SRVY_ID , UP_SRVY_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UP_SRVY_ID ORDER BY REG_DTTM) AS RNK FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY_TYCD = 'SRVY_GNRL' AND UP_SRVY_ID IS NOT NULL ), DVCLAS_SBJCT AS ( /* 분반 과목 - 설문 연결 */ SELECT SRVY.SBJCT_ID , SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY.BYTEAM_SUBSRVY_USEYN , SUB.SRVY_ID AS SUB_SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY LEFT JOIN SUB_SRVY_RANKED SUB ON SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID AND SUB.RNK = 1 WHERE SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND ( SRVY.SRVY_GRP_ID = (SELECT SRVY_GRP_ID FROM BASE_SRVY WHERE DVCLAS_REGYN = 'Y') OR SRVY.SRVY_ID = (SELECT SRVY_ID FROM BASE_SRVY WHERE DVCLAS_REGYN = 'N') ) ), SRVY_TEAM AS ( /* 하위 설문 - 팀 연결 */ SELECT ST.SRVY_ID , TM.TEAM_ID , TM.TEAM_GRP_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT ST JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_ID = ST.TEAM_ID ) SELECT SBJCT.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , DS.SRVY_ID , DS.BYTEAM_SUBSRVY_USEYN , ST.TEAM_GRP_ID , TG.TEAM_GRPNM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN DVCLAS_SBJCT DS ON DS.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN SRVY_TEAM ST ON ST.SRVY_ID = DS.SUB_SRVY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP TG ON TG.TEAM_GRP_ID = ST.TEAM_GRP_ID AND TG.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND TG.USEYN = 'Y' AND TG.DELYN = 'N' ORDER BY SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvySelect 설 명 : 설문조회 */ WITH SBJCT_USER AS ( /* 과목 수강생 목록 */ SELECT ATNDLC.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON SRVY.SBJCT_ID = ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID WHERE ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} ), SRVY_IDS AS ( /* 하위 설문 포함 대상 설문 목록 */ SELECT SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} UNION ALL SELECT SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' ), SUB_SRVY AS ( /* 하위 설문 단건 */ SELECT SRVY_ID, UP_SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) SELECT SRVY.* , CASE WHEN SUB.SRVY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'SRVY_TEAM' ELSE 'SRVY' END AS SRVY_GBN , USR.USERNM AS RGTRNM , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , (SELECT COUNT(PTCP.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP WHERE PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL AND PTCP.SRVY_ID IN (SELECT SRVY_ID FROM SRVY_IDS) AND PTCP.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM SBJCT_USER)) AS PTCP_USER_CNT , TM.TEAM_GRP_ID , TG.TEAM_GRPNM , NVL(SUB.SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID) AS SUB_SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = SRVY.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = SRVY.RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN SUB_SRVY SUB ON SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT ST ON ST.SRVY_ID = SUB.SRVY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_ID = ST.TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP TG ON TG.TEAM_GRP_ID = TM.TEAM_GRP_ID AND TG.SBJCT_ID = SRVY.SBJCT_ID AND TG.USEYN = 'Y' AND TG.DELYN = 'N' WHERE SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvyTeamList 설 명 : 설문팀목록조회 */ SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY_TRGT.TEAM_ID , TM.TEAMNM , SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT SRVY_TRGT ON SRVY_TRGT.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_ID = SRVY_TRGT.TEAM_ID AND TM.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' WHERE SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId}
/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvyIdSelect 설 명 : 설문아이디조회 */ SELECT SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY_GRP_ID = #{srvyGrpId} AND SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvyTeamGrpSubSrvyList 설 명 : 설문팀그룹부설문목록조회 */ SELECT TEAM.TEAM_ID , TEAM.TEAMNM , NVL(USR.USERNM, '-') AS LEADERNM , (SELECT COUNT(MBR.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR MBR WHERE MBR.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID) AS TEAM_MBR_CNT , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(SRVY.SRVY_CTS, 4000, 1) AS SRVY_CTS FROM TB_LMS_TEAM TEAM LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR LMBR ON LMBR.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID AND LMBR.LDRYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = LMBR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT ST ON ST.TEAM_ID = TEAM.TEAM_ID AND ST.SRVY_ID IN (SELECT SRVY_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId}) LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON SRVY.SRVY_ID = ST.SRVY_ID AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} WHERE TEAM.TEAM_GRP_ID = #{teamGrpId} ORDER BY TEAM.TEAM_ID ASC

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.quizTeamQstnsCmptnynSelect 설 명 : 설문팀문제출제완료여부조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(CASE WHEN SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' THEN 1 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM TB_LMS_SRVY WHERE UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND DELYN = 'N' AND USEYN = 'Y'

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.qstnCopySrvyList 설 명 : 문제가져오기설문목록조회 */ SELECT NVL(SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_ID , NVL(SUB_SRVY.SRVY_TTL, SRVY.SRVY_TTL) AS SRVY_TTL FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = SRVY.SBJCT_ID AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB_SRVY ON SRVY.SRVY_ID = SUB_SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID AND SUB_SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SUB_SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SUB_SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' AND SUB_SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' WHERE SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.stdntSrvySelect 설 명 : 학생설문조회 */ SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID AS UP_SRVY_ID , NVL(TRGT.SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_CTS , CASE WHEN SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'SRVY_TEAM' ELSE 'SRVY' END AS SRVY_GBN , SRVY.SBJCT_ID , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.MRK_RFLTYN , SRVY.MRK_OYN , SRVY.EVL_SCR_TYCD , SRVY.RSLT_OPEN_TYCD , SRVY.BYTEAM_SUBSRVY_USEYN , TRGT.TEAM_ID , TM.TEAM_GRP_ID , TG.TEAM_GRPNM , CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_SRVY' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS SRVY_PRGRS_STS , PTCP.PTCP_SDTTM , PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM , PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_ID , NVL(PTCP.PTCP_EVL_SCR, 0) AS PTCP_EVL_SCR , NVL(PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN, 'N') AS SRVY_PTCP_EVLYN , #{userId} AS USER_ID , USR.USERNM , NVL(DEPT.DEPTNM, '-') AS DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = SRVY.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB_SRVY ON SUB_SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID AND SUB_SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SUB_SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT TRGT ON TRGT.SRVY_ID = SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = NVL(SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID, SRVY.SRVY_ID) AND PTCP.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_ID = TRGT.TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_GRP TG ON TG.TEAM_GRP_ID = TM.TEAM_GRP_ID AND TG.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND TG.USEYN = 'Y' AND TG.DELYN = 'N' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ( (#{upSrvyId} <> #{srvyId} AND SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{upSrvyId} AND SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId}) OR (#{upSrvyId} = #{srvyId} AND SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{upSrvyId}) )

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.admSrvySelect 설 명 : 관리자전체설문조회 */ SELECT SRVY.* , TRGT.SRVY_TRGT_TYCD , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'USER_TYCD' AND CD = TRGT.SRVY_TRGT_TYCD) AS SRVY_TRGT_TYNM , CHRT.SMSTR_CHRTNM , CHRT.DGRS_YR , ORG.ORGNM , ORG.ORG_ID , CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_SRVY' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS SRVY_PRGRS_STS FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT TRGT ON SRVY.SRVY_ID = TRGT.SRVY_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SRVY.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID WHERE SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'HOMEPAGE_SRVY' AND SRVY.SRVY_TYCD = 'SRVY_WHOL' AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.stdntSrvyLctrEvlSelect 설 명 : 학생설문강의평가조회 */ SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID AS UP_SRVY_ID , SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID AS SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_CTS , SUB_SRVY.SBJCT_ID , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_TYCD , SRVY.RSLT_OPEN_TYCD , SRVY.MRK_OYN , CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_SRVY' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS SRVY_PRGRS_STS , PTCP.PTCP_SDTTM , PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM , PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS USERNM , NVL((SELECT DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}),'-') AS DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB_SRVY ON SRVY.SRVY_ID = SUB_SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID AND SUB_SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SUB_SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID AND PTCP.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SUB_SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{upSrvyId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.trgtWholSrvySelect 설 명 : 대상전체설문조회 */ SELECT SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_CTS , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.RSLT_OPEN_TYCD , CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_SRVY' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS SRVY_PRGRS_STS , PTCP.PTCP_SDTTM , PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM , PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) AS USERNM , NVL((SELECT DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT DEPT JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON DEPT.DEPT_ID = USR.DEPT_ID WHERE USR.USER_ID = #{userId}),'-') AS DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID AND PTCP.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE SRVY.SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y'

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.stdntSrvyLctrEvlListPaging 설 명 : 학생설문강의평가목록페이징 */
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(SRVY.SRVY_ID) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , SRVY.SRVY_ID , SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_TYCD , SRVY.SRVY_TTL , SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM , SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM , SRVY.MRK_OYN , SRVY.RSLT_OPEN_TYCD , CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN SYSDATE < TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'PRE_SRVY' WHEN SYSDATE > TO_DATE(SRVY.SRVY_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS SRVY_PRGRS_STS , PTCP.PTCP_SDTTM , PTCP.PTCP_EDTTM , PTCP.SRVY_PTCP_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON SRVY.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY UP_SRVY ON SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = UP_SRVY.SRVY_ID AND UP_SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND UP_SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND UP_SRVY.SRVY_QSTNS_CMPTNYN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP PTCP ON PTCP.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID WHERE SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY.SRVY_TYCD LIKE '%EXAM%' AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID IS NOT NULL AND SRVY.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId}

/* SQL ID : SrvyDAO.srvyLctrEvlSbjctPtcpList 설 명 : 설문강의평가과목참여목록 */ WITH ATNDLC AS ( SELECT ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID , ATNDLC.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATNDLC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND USR.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SBJCT.SBJCTNM) AS LINE_NO , SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID , SRVY.SRVY_ID , ORG.ORGNM , SBJCT.SBJCT_YR , SBJCT.SBJCT_SMSTR , SBJCT.SBJCT_ID , SBJCT.CRCLMN_NO AS SBJCT_CD , SBJCT.SBJCTNM , SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO , PROF_USER.USERNM AS PROFNM , COUNT(A.USER_ID) AS STDNT_CNT , COUNT(P.USER_ID) AS PTCP_CNT , COUNT(A.USER_ID) - COUNT(P.USER_ID) AS NOT_PTCP_CNT FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SRVY JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT SBJCT ON SRVY.SBJCT_ID = SBJCT.SBJCT_ID AND SBJCT.DELYN = 'N' AND SBJCT.USEYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT CHRT ON SBJCT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = CHRT.SMSTR_CHRT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ORG ORG ON CHRT.ORG_ID = ORG.ORG_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON USR.USER_ID = #{userId} AND USR.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' AND USR.USER_TYCD = 'ADM' JOIN TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT USR_AUTHRT ON USR_AUTHRT.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_AUTHRT AUTHRT ON AUTHRT.AUTHRT_ID = USR_AUTHRT.AUTHRT_ID AND AUTHRT.AUTHRT_ID = 'AUTHRT_ID00012' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SBJCT_ID, USER_ID FROM (SELECT SBJCT_ID, USER_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SBJCT_ID ORDER BY ROWNUM) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT_ADM WHERE SBJCT_ADM_TYCD = 'PROF') WHERE RN = 1 ) PROF ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = PROF.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_USER PROF_USER ON PROF.USER_ID = PROF_USER.USER_ID AND PROF_USER.USER_ID_STSCD = 'APRV_CMPTN' LEFT JOIN ATNDLC A ON SBJCT.SBJCT_ID = A.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP P ON A.USER_ID = P.USER_ID AND P.SRVY_ID = SRVY.SRVY_ID AND P.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL WHERE SRVY.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND SRVY.SRVY_TYCD LIKE '%EXAM%' AND SRVY.DELYN = 'N' AND SRVY.USEYN = 'Y' AND SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID = #{srvyId} GROUP BY SRVY.SRVY_ID, ORG.ORGNM, SBJCT.SBJCT_YR, SBJCT.SBJCT_SMSTR , SBJCT.SBJCT_ID, SBJCT.CRCLMN_NO, SBJCT.SBJCTNM, SBJCT.DVCLAS_NO, PROF_USER.USERNM, SRVY.UP_SRVY_ID
